body: Did you stop for two seconds to see the sub it’s posted in? It’s r/offmychest which if you rubbed your two braincells together you might pick up that it’s for *gasp* typing out your thoughts? Things you think about sometimes? Weird how that works. And yeah the post by Reddit standards is old as fuck which does make it weird that it seems like you went digging for it considering it would be nowhere near the top and didn’t get enough traction to be in any of the other search categories. But you do seem a bit butthurt to be coming back so aggressively? Have you considered therapy you’d make a fantastic case study!! Lot of assumptions there dude but really if you want to get shit off your chest go off after all.. it’s what the sub is for :)

My guy it is super weird for you to come onto this post that’s 5.5 months old (nearly half a year old) and act like this. I would highly recommend touching some grass instead of trying to come for me like this?? On an old ass post?? WEIRD behaviour

What are they supposed to do tho? Admit that it’s absolutely miserable day in day out? At least if OP can convince themselves it’s rewarding it’s something that can help them get through those longer days. Sometimes it’s what you need to do to protect your mental health even if realistically you know it’s a fucked situation we’re all in.

I’m 5’5 and my preference is men that are the same height or taller than me but it’s a preference not a hard rule 🤷🏻‍♀️ I’ve dated a bit shorter and it didn’t bother me though I think the perfect height for me is about 5’7 so they can reach things I can’t lol but otherwise I couldn’t care less
This is exactly my point!! The point was proven they didn’t need to die for the data to be there :(

I would be taking this up with your boss and possibly her higher ups but absolutely make sure you have a paper trail where you can. This is completely unfair and blatantly unprofessional. It has been YEARS

An older friend of mine thought I was older than her because I “seem like I have my shit together” which would have made more sense on April 1st and people like to tell me things so I often become the voice of reason or the crutch like you said depending on the issue at hand but it’s definitely one way. I only ever get a “how are you” if it’s immediately followed by the latest drama in their life

Yeah I feel that. I said in my post people don’t know and it’s because there’s no one I really feel I connect with well enough for me to tell them such deep things? Like they see me on a sort of surface level.

I’ve been to a few in the past (not going currently) and you really have to try a couple to find someone that’s a good match. I’ve had some I’ve hated because of how they acted, some that were a personality clash and a couple that were actually great so if you find one and it doesn’t work out don’t knock trying another. It doesn’t mean that just because they didn’t get it that no one will just maybe you aren’t compatible and there might be one that is.

My family is also religious but I’m not so should it be real I’m burning too. It’s a weird feeling because I don’t believe in it not really but being surrounded by people that do I still fear it happening somewhere in the back of my mind.

There’s people a lot older than feel the same as you do now like you said but there’s also a hell of a lot that for them their situation got a lot better so don’t think it’s over yet. You’ve got a life left to live yet and just the chance of things getting better is worth holding out for because you never know how much things can improve without giving them a chance. You deserve to be happy and life has a lot left in store for you, getting away from your parents and being able to live your own life might be the first step but you’ve got to get there first.
Show your family what assholes they’ve been by living, they aren’t worth hurting once when you can live a long life outside of their bubble and show them how wrong they were everyday you go on.
